name: ocarina-of-time-review-scores-example
note: STUDIO EXAMPLE (adv-20261104-review-scores-template), jobs/test only: never copied to jobs/render as is. Before a live render, run reviewscores.py fetch again and copy the new totals and read_at; the job is refused when totals_read_at is over 180 minutes old. Reviews embargo lifted 4 Nov 2026; game out 5 Nov on Switch 2. Totals read 4 Nov 13:05Z: Metacritic 96 from 81 critic reviews (80 positive); OpenCritic top critic average 96, 100% recommend, 17 top critics, 30 reviews. Spread scores as each outlet printed them (OpenCritic ScoreFormat): IGN 9/10 (Logan Plant), Eurogamer 5/5 (Christian Donlan), Nintendo Life 9/10 (Oliver Reynolds), VGC 5/5 (Andy Robinson), Saudi Gamer verdict «أسطورية», the top of its five-word scale (Issam Al-Shahwan, read on saudigamer.com; OpenCritic records it as 5/5). Lowest on both aggregators: RPG Site 8/10 (Scott White, with Alex Donaldson). Footage: Nintendo store Overview trailer (720p, the only official copy, as on the 3 Nov UK launch job). picture: ocarina-overview.mp4 at 72 s (hook) and 94 s (payoff), new stretches. Sound: our bed (neon_b). The Overview trailer is narrated almost end to end (faster-whisper, 4 Nov: longest speech-free stretch 186.7 to 211.4 s, 24.8 s, shorter than the Reel), and a card-led numbers Reel may take our bed (trailer-sound rule, 23 Oct, point 1). The 'music_only' split is the alternative once speech_check reads the music stem. sensitive: none.
